question: Under what temporal condition of practice is old age and death said to be destroyed?
premises: That practice, when done for one year, is the condition stated.
Under that condition, old age and death are destroyed.
inference: When this practice has been practiced for one year, old age and death are destroyed.
uncertainties: The practice itself is not named in this verse.
plain_english: When practiced for one year, old age and death are destroyed.
